summary.tldr: Requires the Minister of Health to develop a national strategy on brain injuries and report to Parliament on it.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Health to develop a national strategy with provincial governments, Indigenous groups and other stakeholders.
Includes measures to promote prevention, training, research, data collection, information sharing, and national guidelines on brain injury prevention, diagnosis and management.
Promotes awareness and education, with a focus on public understanding and the rights of people living with a brain injury.
Supports national, provincial and local brain injury groups and service providers to build mental health resources for people with brain injuries and their families.
Encourages consultation with mental health professionals in schools, sports organisations and workplaces to support people dealing with brain injury, mental health and addiction problems.
Requires the Minister to table a strategy report in Parliament within 18 months, then evaluate the strategy and table a follow-up report within five years.
